# Waffle

Contents: [Use cases](#use-cases), [Chart IDs](#chart-ids), [Minimal spec](#minimal-spec), [Data](#data), [Options](#options), [Annotations](#annotations), [Sizing](#sizing), [Fixtures](#fixtures), [Not for](#not-for).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

Share of a whole as a grid of square cells, one panel per category: label, headline total and whole-cell segments (largest-remainder rounding), filled from the bottom left. Type `waffle`.

## Use cases

- One share of 100%, such as 30% of customers
- Several shares side by side with one baseline
- Stacked segments of one whole

## Chart IDs

- `waffle.cells`: fixture `single-share`
- `waffle.square`: fixture `share-squares`

## Minimal spec

```json
{
  "type": "waffle",
  "data": {
    "categories": [{ "id": "high-spend", "label": "Share of high-spending customers out of all customers" }],
    "series": [{ "id": "share", "label": "High spenders", "values": [30] }]
  },
  "options": { "title": "Three in ten customers are high spenders", "source": "Illustrative data" }
}
```

## Data

A `cell` is a number, null or a value object; see [Value cell](options.md#value-cell).

| Path | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| valueKind | string |  | Default valueKind for all series. One of `'fraction'`. |
| categories | array | yes | Panels, one waffle each, in left-to-right order. |
| categories[].id | string | yes | Panel identity used to match keyed values. |
| categories[].label | string |  | Text above the panel, wrapped to the panel width; defaults to the category id. |
| series | array | yes | Segments of every panel, filled in this order. One series is a single share; several make a stacked waffle. The values of one panel add up to 100 or less; the rest of the panel stays empty. Those rest cells use color.othersMark (default color.others), deepened just enough to clear the mark floor on the page, with no outline; marks.othersOutline does not apply to them. |
| series[].valueKind | string |  | Multiply numbers by 100 into pct cells; explicit pct cells stay in percent units. One of `'fraction'`. |
| series[].id | string | yes | Segment identity used by keyed values and legend entries. |
| series[].label | string |  | Segment name in the legend; defaults to the series id. |
| series[].values | (cell \| { categoryId, value: cell })[] | yes | Percent of the whole (0 to 100) in panel order, or keyed entries pairing a categoryId with a value. Under valueKind fraction, 0.3 reads 30%. |
| series[].colorRole | string |  | Theme color role of this segment; the palette is used when absent. One of good, bad, warn, neutral, neutralLight, highlight, total, others; series-N for step N of the theme ramp, 1-based (series-2 is color.series[1]); or status-<key> for a theme status colour. A hex colour goes in fill. |
| series[].fill | string |  | Authored fill of this segment. |
| series[].format | string |  | Format-by-example for this segment value, for example 0.0%. Values are in percent units. The panel total takes the format of the first series; a cell format wins for its own value. |

## Options

| Path | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| grid | object |  | `{"rows":10,"columns":10}` | Cell grid of every panel. Default 10 rows by 10 columns, so one cell is 1%. One cell is 100 / (rows × columns) percent, and each segment is rounded to whole cells. |
| grid.rows | integer |  | `10` | Rows of cells in every panel, 1 to 50. |
| grid.columns | integer |  | `10` | Columns of cells in every panel, 1 to 50. |
| fillFrom | string | `'bottom'`, `'top'` | `'bottom'` | Where the fill starts. 'bottom' (default) starts at the bottom left, fills each row left to right and moves up. 'top' starts at the top left and moves down. A partly filled row fills from the left. |
| headline | string | `'value'`, `'none'` |  | Automatic: a single-segment panel prints its value as a big number; several segments print their values in the key or below each grid. Authored 'value' prints a labelled total for several segments, in the format of the series or options.format. 'none' leaves the headline out. |
| cellNote | string | `'auto'`, `'none'` |  | 'auto' (default) prints the note "One cell = 5%" under the chart when one cell is not 1% of the whole, so a coarse grid reads right. 'none' leaves it out. The wording comes from strings.cellNote, with '{value}' for the percent. |
| variant | string | `'cells'`, `'square'` | `'cells'` | 'cells' (default) draws the grid of cells. 'square' draws one solid square per panel whose AREA is the share (side = square root of the share × panel side), anchored at the fillFrom corner on the left, inside a pale tint of the same colour that stands for 100%. The headline prints under the panel. Square mode takes exactly one series (a nested second square would read as an L-shape, not a share) and refuses grid; there are no cells, so no cell note prints. Area understates differences (59% is 15 times 4% but only about 4 times as wide), so keep the headline. |
| reference | object |  |  | Square mode only. One reference share for ALL panels, drawn as a dashed square outline of that area in every panel (not in the reference panel itself) and named once in a key line above the panels (a note when legend is 'none' or a pinned size has no room). One reference keeps the outline meaning the same in every panel. |
| reference.categoryId | string |  |  | Panel whose share is the reference. Give this or value. |
| reference.value | number |  |  | Reference share in percent, above 0 and up to 100 (a 0% reference has no square to outline). Give this or categoryId. |
| reference.label | string |  |  | Outline label; default the panel label and its share, such as "Population 4%". Required with value, since a bare share does not say what it stands for (waffle-reference-label-required). |
| arrows | boolean |  | `false` | Square mode only. true draws an arrow in each gap between adjacent panels, at the height of the reference outline (or mid-panel without one). Default false: the panels are separate measures, and an arrow reads as a flow or a cause. |
| panelGroups | array |  |  | Runs of panels that tell one act of the story: a caption under each run and one colour per run. Members must exist, belong to at most one group, and be contiguous in category order. |
| panelGroups[].id | string |  |  | Group id. |
| panelGroups[].panels | array |  |  | Member panels, contiguous in category order. |
| panelGroups[].label | string |  |  | Caption centred under the group, wrapped to its width. |
| panelGroups[].colorRole | string |  |  | Fill colour role of the group's panels; the series colour otherwise. Needs a single series. One of good, bad, warn, neutral, neutralLight, highlight, total, others; series-N for step N of the theme ramp, 1-based (series-2 is color.series[1]); or status-<key> for a theme status colour. A hex colour goes in fill. |
| subtotal | object |  |  | Cells mode with one panel only. Sums the first segments and prints the sum with its label: beside a bracket that spans their rows when the key stands beside the grid, under the key otherwise. The sum takes the first series' format. |
| subtotal.series | array |  |  | The summed segments: the first series and the ones right after it, in series order. |
| subtotal.label | string |  |  | What the sum stands for, such as 'within a day'; printed after the sum. |

Plus the [shared options](options.md). This type does not accept `detailFields`, `labels`, `categoryLabels`, `valueAxis.tickStep`, `valueAxis.log`, `valueAxis.reverse`, `valueAxis.break`, `categoryAxis`, `secondaryAxis`, `rowLabels`, `sort`, `topN`, `bandFraction`, `highlight`, `story`, `hatchStrength`, `colorblindSafe`, `rounding`.

## Annotations

This type takes no annotations.

## Sizing

Floor 240 × 200 px; fit `content`.
Below 240 px wide or 200 px high, down to the compact floor of 160 × 160 px, the chart draws in compact mode; `belowMinimum: 'refuse'` refuses there instead.

Below the floor a render is refused with `size-below-floor` and the pixels it needs. `measure` returns the natural and comfortable size for a given spec; see [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing).

## Fixtures

| ID | Kind | Use case |
|---|---|---|
| single-share | example | One panel: 30% of customers, a label, a headline and a 10 by 10 grid |
| two-panels | example | Two panels with labels of different lengths: grids and headlines keep one baseline |
| stacked-segments | example | One panel with three segments: whole-cell rounding, values beside the grid, 13 empty cells and a subtotal bracket |
| fraction-input | example | Fractions of 1 under valueKind fraction, on a wide 5 by 20 grid |
| top-fill-no-headline | example | Fill from the top on a coarse 4 by 5 grid, no headline |
| coarse-grid-cell-note | example | A 4 by 5 grid: one cell is 5%, and the note says so in the host wording |
| seven-panels-narrow | torture | Torture: seven panels near the minimum cell size, a missing value, a value under half a cell and a full panel |
| share-squares | example | Square mode: five shares as solid squares in pale 100% squares, one dashed reference, two captioned groups |
| share-squares-arrows | example | Square mode with arrows on: three panels, a number reference with its label, arrows in the gaps at the outline height |

## Not for

Levels or values that are not shares of a whole; waffle fills part of 100%. Use bar or column for levels, pie for slices of a total.
